thread.title: Apple's New iPad Gets Rave Reviews but Will It Be Enough to Bolster Flat Sales?

author: thestreet.com
title: Apple's New iPad Gets Rave Reviews but Will It Be Enough to Bolster Flat Sales?
text:
Even though Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported record revenue of $88.3 billion in the quarter ended in December, sales of the company's iPad rose only slightly.
Apple, an Action Alerts PLUS holding, sold 13.2 million units of the device, up from 13.1 million in the previous quarter.
While the iPhone continues to be the company's main moneymaker, slumping iPhone X sales dictate that more of the company's other products need to pick up the slack.
Good thing for Apple that its new iPad has been getting rave reviews.
The new device is on the cheaper side, with a base price of $329, features a stylus pen that was originally only available on the more expensive iPad Pro. Engadget declared the new iPad "the best budget tablet you can buy right now."
The Verge was similarly effusive in its praise for the device, declaring, "There isn't a single viable competitor to the iPad."
Apple reported earlier this year that it had 1.3 billion active devices around the world, a 30% increase in two years and the most active devices it's ever had.
For the just-concluded quarter, the company expects to generate revenue of between $60 billion and $62 billion. The company is scheduled to report its quarterly results on May 1.
